hero.title: Join Mōchirīī
hero.intro: There is room in the guild for pretty Wanderers. We gather in Asia Pacific & players farther away are welcome when the ping works for them.

steps.title: The Joining Path
intro: Five small steps take you from the gate to your first guild event.

items.title: Enter the Guild
items.description: Open Discord & follow the welcome prompt. A moderator will verify you & open the guild channels.

items.title: Know the Guild
items.description: Read the Tome & Ranks to learn our conduct, roles & who to ask for help.

items.title: Share Your Name
items.description: Post your in-game name or UID & time zone so we can find you & match event times.

items.title: Receive Your Rank
items.description: A leader will assign your first rank & show you the channels you need.

items.title: Share the Road
items.description: Join an event, ask questions, say hello. It's all in the simple things.

quickStart.title: Your Next Step
body: We will help with the rest.

checklist.title: A Good Fit
checklist.intro: Mōchirīī suits casual players who enjoy playing together when it suits them.

items.title: Kindness Comes First
items.text: Be ncie & give people room to recover from mistakes.
items.label: Read the Tome

items.title: Real Life Comes First
items.text: Join when you can & give notice before a longer break.

items.title: UTC+8 Event Times
items.text: Most planned guild events follow Asia Pacific hours. Check that the timing & ping suit you.
items.label: See Events

items.title: Discord Keeps Us Connected
items.text: Roles, announcements & event planning live there.
items.label: Join on Discord

items.title: Questions Are Welcome
items.text: Ask freely. Leaders & veteran members will help you anytime they can.

culture.title: Life in the Guild
intro: Guild life is meant to be light, casual & considerate.

cards.title: Be Nice & Respectful
cards.description: Keep chat welcoming, assume good intent & repair mistakes calmly.

cards.title: Be Consistent
cards.description: RSVP for planned events & tell a leader before a longer break.

cards.title: Share What You Know
cards.description: Offer clear tips, simple answers & room for each members's own style.

cards.title: Check the Latest Notice
cards.description: Discord events show final times, roles & requirements. Read the pinned note before an event.

notes.title: Good to Know
body: Voice chat is optional unless an event notice requires it.
Everyday questions begin with middle leadership, Hall Leaders handle wider concerns.
When you feel lost, ask early. One question can spare a long detour.
